name: Baku Ane ~Otouto Shibocchau zo!~
original_name: ばくあね ～弟しぼっちゃうぞ！～
source:
The protagonist is a famous soccer player, but due to a leg injury from a game, he must now rest until it heals. When he returns home, he is warmly greeted by his 4 older sisters whom he hasn't seen for a long time.

However, because his clubmates have play a prank on him and fill his bag with ero manga, their relationships immediately plummet after they find out about it.

While trying to explain the situation to no avail, one of them suggests that they themselves should help him escape the 2D world and be interested in healthy adult women. Little does he know, all of his sisters love him more than a brother.

And so, this is the beginning of a ridiculous erotic life between our protagonist and his 4 tempting older sisters.

[Translated from [url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_bb/bakuane/story.html]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名小有名气的足球运动员，却因在比赛中腿部受伤，不得不暂时回家静养直到痊愈。回到久违的家中时，许久未见的4位姐姐热情洋溢地迎接了他的归来。

然而，由于社团队友们搞恶作剧往他的行李包里塞满了工口漫画，被姐姐们当场翻出来后，他在姐姐们心目中的形象顿时一落千丈。

无论他怎么拼命解释都无济于事；就在这时，其中一位姐姐提议说，干脆由姐姐们亲自出手帮他脱离二次元世界，让他对健康成熟的现实女性重拾兴趣。主人公做梦也没有想到，其实每一位姐姐都对他怀有超越姐弟界限的深深爱意。

就这样，主人公与4位魅惑姐姐之间荒唐又火辣的色气同居生活正式拉开了帷幕。

[译自[url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_bb/bakuane/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
